🏡 VA Loan Buyers – No Minimum Credit Score | Eric Martinez Top Military Realtor
Are you a veteran or active-duty service member looking to buy a home in Killeen, Temple, Belton, or Fort Hood, Texas? 🇺🇸 With your VA Loan, there’s NO minimum credit score required to get started!
I’m Eric Martinez – Top Military Friendly Realtor with Keller Williams | Barrientos Group. With 17+ years of experience helping military families relocate and purchase their dream homes in Central Texas, I’ll guide you every step of the way.

📲 Call/Text: 254-913-0132
✉️ Email: eric.martinez@kw.com
🌐 Website: call4eric.thebarrientosgroup.com

👉 Don’t wait — homes are selling fast. Let’s get you pre-approved and into your new home today!

#VALoan #MilitaryFriendlyRealtor #KilleenTX #TempleTX #BeltonTX #FortHood #TopRealtorNearMe #EricMartinez #CallEricMartinez #buyWithEric #barrientosgroup #bestrealtornearme
